Attack branch devin/pp/adv/security-privacy-2994371e @ 9d650398e7ab794ad78c5256d963575c40dd7d91 (tests only; no production code, existing tests, migrations or comments touched; no PR opened). 5 new test files, 13 attack boundaries, 8 confirmed breaks (1×P1, 4×P2, 3×P3), 0×P0.

HELD (attacks that did NOT break anything — all VERIFIED on the SHA above):
- Edge access log redaction of hostile route segments (email/path/token/traversal): `cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && deno test -A --no-check --config deno.json adv_secprv_log_leakage.test.ts` → ok (7 of 9 pass; log artifact artifacts/adv-security-privacy/attack-edge-adv_secprv_log_leakage.log). Also held: email/path/token-shaped and oversize x-request-id replaced (only provider-key prefixes slip — see break); hostile PostgREST error details never reach body or logs; unhandled throws with hostile name/message/code/stack logged categorically only; RevenueCat webhook hostile ids/aliases/product ids/secrets never surface; client IP / X-Forwarded-For / UA / referer / cookies absent from logs and responses; public + 5xx responses carry hardening headers and generic bodies.
- Bounded request bodies: chunked body without Content-Length over the small-route cap → 413 with no leak; hostile/huge advisory Content-Length refused before read without crash; invalid UTF-8, non-object JSON, __proto__/constructor keys, 20k-deep JSON → generic 400 (adv_secprv_input_sanitization.test.ts, 3 of 7 pass).
- Mobile diagnostics gate: runtime config ships transportEnabled/providerApproved/disclosuresApproved/nativePrivacyApproved=false, dsn=null; initializeDiagnostics()→'disabled', native='blocked_unverified_native_filtering', persistentQueue=false, provider module never loaded; capture entry points inert and non-throwing before init; 9 hostile DSN variants (http, look-alike host, userinfo, query, trailing path, uppercase key, newline, tunnel path) → blocked_dsn even with all approvals true; missing generated release identity → blocked_identity; null-DSN options are enabled:false and beforeSend/beforeBreadcrumb/beforeSendTransaction return null. `cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci __tests__/adv/secprvDiagnosticsPipeline.test.ts` (27 of 31 pass; artifact attack-mobile-secprvDiagnosticsPipeline.log).
- Reporter: error with hostile name/message/code/user/request/stack → allow-listed event, 'Error details removed', only app:///<bundle> frames, no canary; same error object never re-reported, hard cap 20 events; >32 KiB stack never parsed; string/number/null/undefined throwables handled; throwing Proxy traps, throwing parser, rejecting captureEvent, throwing clearScopes never escape.
- Scrubbed transport: JS envelope with user/request/breadcrumbs/extra/contexts/server_name/fingerprint/vars/context_line/attachment+session items/hostile envelope header → sink receives only {event_id,sent_at} header + one event with the fixed allow-listed key set and identity tags; native cocoa envelope with hostile symbols/packages/device contexts/threads/uuid/kernel/response headers → all stripped, unreferenced images dropped, frames bounded to 50 and limited to function/image_addr/in_app/instruction_addr/package; cyclic, 100k-frame and Proxy-trapped events bounded or refused without throw; 1M-item envelope → null; hostile identity (path in modelVersion, email in policyVersion, non-hex revision) disables the transport.
- BufferedAnalytics: 100 violating events → 0 transported, pendingCount 0, onViolation receives only path+rule (no canary/email); failing transport re-buffer bounded (≤20 after 50 failed rounds).
- Repo-wide: `npx --yes deno@2.5.6 check --node-modules-dir=none --frozen --lock=deno.lock supabase/functions/api/index.ts` exit 0 (artifacts/adv-security-privacy/edge-frozen-check.log). `pnpm --filter @pickle/analytics test` exit 0, 43/43 (baseline-analytics.log). `cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci src/diagnostics` baseline 6 suites / 122 tests pass (baseline-mobile-diagnostics.log). Full Edge suite `cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && deno task test` → 843 passed (31 steps), 9 failed, 58 ignored, exit 1 (edge-full-suite.log): the 9 failures are exactly the 9 new attack tests listed under breaks; the 58 ignored are the pre-existing XC_PG_URL-gated live-Postgres tests (no Postgres in this run — not counted as a pass). New test hygiene: `deno fmt/lint/check` on adv_secprv_*.test.ts exit 0 (edge-lint-check.log); `cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0 (mobile-tsc.log); root `npx eslint apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/secprv*.test.ts` exit 0 (mobile-eslint.log); `npx prettier --check` clean.

NOT_YET_VERIFIABLE (needs Mac/device): native Sentry SDK actually initialising with autoSessionTracking/attachScreenshot/attachViewHierarchy/enableNative disabled at runtime, and no native crash queue on disk — requires `scripts/mac-full-verify.sh` on the M4 runner (coordinator-owned; not run) plus a device/simulator inspection of the app container for `io.sentry` cache directories after a forced crash. Not attempted: any production Supabase, RevenueCat or App Store Connect interaction.
